title: Product-distribution vector noise stability
statement: Let $V$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $W$ be a real inner-product space, and let $f:V^n\to W$. For $0\le\rho\le1$, define the noise stability of $f$ to be the product-distribution expectation of the inner product between $f(x)$ and the vector-valued noise operator applied to $f$ at $x$.
